2608.12253.title: One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL
2608.12253.paper_summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning for human-AI interaction typically relies on a single large language model to simulate user behavior. We show that this approach systematically fails to generalize, and trace the failure to simulator collapse: because the simulator LLM is mode-collapsed, an LLM policy trained against it overfits to narrow strategies that exploit the simulator's dominant mode, and such a policy transfers poorly to unseen simulators and real users. We formalize this collapse theoretically and propose two complementary solutions, one at inference time and one at training time. The inference-time solution, Verbalized Sampling, broadens the simulator's behavior by sampling from a verbalized response distribution, reducing mode collapse. The training-time solution, Co-Training, jointly optimizes the policy against a population of trainable simulators, preventing it from overfitting to any single simulator's mode. We validate both solutions on three multi-turn benchmarks: Persuasion for Good, $τ^2$-bench, and CooperBench. Verbalized Sampling improves held-out success by up to 9% over single-simulator RL, and Co-Training pushes gains further to 14%; the human study shows similar gain on real users. Both solutions preserve the policy diversity that collapses under single-simulator RL. To support further work in this direction, we release SCOPE, an open-source framework for Population Co-Training multi-agent RL. More broadly, our results suggest that the diversity of the training environment, not only the policy, is critical to the generalization of multi-turn RL to real-world deployment.
2608.12253.paper_summary_zh: 多智能體強化學習在人機互動中通常依賴於單一大型語言模型來模擬用戶行為。<lb/>我們顯示這種方法系統性地無法泛化，並將失敗追溯到模擬器崩潰：因為模擬器 LLM 出現模式崩潰，針對它訓練的 LLM 策略過度擬合於利用模擬器主導模式的狹窄策略，而這樣的策略在未見過的模擬器和真實用戶上轉移效果不佳。<lb/>我們從理論上正式化這種崩潰，並提出兩個互補的解決方案，一個在推理時，另一個在訓練時。<lb/>推理時的解決方案，Verbalized Sampling，通過從口頭化的回應分佈中取樣來擴展模擬器的行為，減少模式崩潰。<lb/>訓練時的解決方案，Co-Training，針對一組可訓練的模擬器共同優化策略，防止其過度擬合於任何單一模擬器的模式。<lb/>我們在三個多輪基準上驗證了這兩個解決方案：Persuasion for Good、$τ^2$-bench 和 CooperBench。<lb/>Verbalized Sampling 在持出成功率上比單一模擬器 RL 提高了最多 9%，而 Co-Training 進一步將增益推高至 14%；人類研究顯示對真實用戶有類似的增益。<lb/>這兩個解決方案保留了在單一模擬器 RL 下崩潰的策略多樣性。<lb/>為了支持這方面的進一步工作，我們發布了 SCOPE，一個開源框架，用於人口協同訓練多智能體 RL。<lb/>更廣泛地說，我們的結果表明，訓練環境的多樣性，而不僅僅是策略，對多輪 RL 在現實世界部署中的泛化至關重要。
